result and holds back the payoff.","A strong open loop: a specific, unexpected or slightly uncomfortable setup the viewer can only settle by watching or clicking."]},{"id":"offer_clarity","label":"Offer clarity","short":"Offer","question":"How clearly does `hook.text` say what the viewer gets if they act, and what to do mechanics: [{"id":"be_specific","label":"Be specific","definition":"Exact details carry it: a precise person, number, place or real result instead of general words."},{"id":"lead_number","label":"Lead with a number","definition":"Opens with a number that carries time, effort or cost, like \"in 1 week\", \"under $5\" or \"10 years\"."},{"id":"call_out","label":"Call out the audience","definition":"Names who it is for so they pick themselves out, like \"New householders:\" or \"Installers,\"."},{"id":"taboo","label":"Lean into the taboo","definition":"Says what competitors are too polite to say out loud."},{"id":"primal_desire","label":"Primal desire","definition":"Sells a deep want (status, safety, belonging, approval, pride) instead of a product feature."},{"id":"curiosity_loop","label":"Curiosity loop","definition":"Shows the setup and hides the payoff behind the click."},{"id":"negative","label":"Negative","definition":"Phrased in the negative: names what the viewer fears, hates or wants to avoid."},{"id":"golden_nugget","label":"Golden nugget testimonial","definition":"Borrows a real customer's own words."},{"id":"transformation","label":"Show the transformation","definition":"Puts the before and the after in front of the viewer instead of describing the result."},{"id":"none","label":"None","definition":"None of these: a plain statement, slogan or label."}]
